[b]27 December 2024, House of Routheil, Routheil[/b]

A young man rushed through the halls of the House of Routheil. He soon arrived in from of a large wooden door with the Coat of Arms carved into it. Just as he was about knock,"Come in. "He quickly entered and closed the door behind him. "Good morning lieutenant Orin", said the person sitting at a large desk that also had the Coat of Arms carved into it. "Good morning Admiral Frione Mirnol, I have the reports you wanted", the lieutenant said. Lieutenant Orin handed the reports to his superior as a knock came from the door. "Enter", The Admiral responded as two men entered the room. "Good morning Admiral", they said in unison. "Good morning to you too, General Vespas and Governor Hezort, what do you require", Frione asked. 

General Vespas started," I was going over some of the reports from the Gadonian territories and noticed that were are running low on military supplies and as for Naval operations, we have been able to take full control of the Bay Islands and Frontier islands and as for the North and Aronian mountains operations are going very well but-", the general paused. "But?", Mirnol inquired. "But we meeting native resistance in these areas and-","And what, just shows them how much because their lives could under Union rule and what happens when you resist for too long", Mirnol interjected.

"General Vespas I kept you because you are an experienced professional but is morality stopping you do what you were ordered to do", Mirnol stated glaring at the general. Governor Hezort decided to intervene to stop an argument from even beginning," Admiral maybe if we pull forces from Gadonia to replenish order forces in Pearland and Aron", he stated. Admiral Mirnol remembered the reports that Lieutenant Orin had delivered and picked up the flies to look at the most recent reports. "General, this says that the Northern operation, Frontier and Bay Islands operations and Aronian mountains operations are already completed, so what in Vata's name were talking abo-", she pause," Wait were you by any chance given the December 10th reports?" "I believe his did Admiral and he's older than most of his peers by a long shot." Hezort said.

Mirnol Sighed, "General Vespas get out of my office and get yourself updated please." General Vespas left the room leaving only Admiral Mirnol and Governor Hezort. "So Governor Hezort, what did you need?" Mirnol asked. " I know you are a busy woman so I will keep this short. I was wonder if making Gadonia a Kingdom now is a good idea?" Hezort asked. "No but it would allow our military to intervene in the region without the international community intervening on Gadonia's side and we have already built up much of the region so they are in serious debt", she answered. Hezort asked," What is even the point of annexing Gadonia if all it has are coal depos-", "Gadonia could have others mineral but the main reason for annexing it, is for its population of over 2 million people which combined with the latest census could increase our population by 7 million.", Mirnol stated. "But Miss, Gadonia could just leech on our economy like...  like leeches", Hezort argued. "Yes but they are getting heavy industrial investments from Aron so I believe that in the next three years, Gadonia's output could overtake both Cavalle and Pearland and with the North free for the taking, Gadonia's will not be expanded for a long time. Governor Hezort stood up and headed to the door," I still believe this is a bad idea but we will have to wait and see Admiral", as head left the room.

[b]Radio and live news of the announcement by Queen Miralina IV[/b]

[b]"Greetings to the people of this land, today marks my first visit to this place. For months your land has been occupied by foreigners that have pushed their customers and culture upon you. Today that ends as I Her Majesty Queen Miralina the forth, Sovereign and protector of Cavalle, Aron, Pearland and now Gadonia. You shall enjoy the freedom and respect of the other constituent nations, the protection of the United Armed Forces of Cavalle and the support of the crown and Union government. With this I declare the newest constituent member of the union, the [u] KINGDOM OF GADONIA [/u] with the city of Frione as her capital. Welcome to United Kingdom of Cavalle.[/b]
